test_policy.notes: SAT or ACT is required for first-year applicants (the CLT is also accepted from fall 2027). Minimums: SAT 500 EBRW and 490 Math, or ACT 18 English-or-Reading and 18 Math, in addition to the GPA minimum. Architecture needs SAT 500/570 or ACT 18 / 23 Math. KSU superscores SAT and ACT separately but does not mix them.

requirements.notes: Application fee $40. Fall 2027 first-year admission requires a minimum 3.0 high school GPA (2.5 through summer 2027) recalculated on the 17-unit Required High School Curriculum, plus qualifying SAT/ACT. International applicants need an official document-by-document credential evaluation including GPA from a NACES or AICE member service (e.g. IEE, The Evaluation Company) and English proficiency. The pages do not mention essays or recommendations; whether the Common App is accepted is not stated on these pages.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 international priority application deadline (documents due Nov. 16, 2026)
deadlines.notes: Priority gives early access to on-campus housing and orientation sign-up, and priority consideration for the Flight to Excellence out-of-state waiver (freshmen: Nov. 2, 2026).

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 international regular application and document deadline
deadlines.notes: Classes begin Aug. 23, 2027. Spring 2027 entry: application Nov. 16, 2026, documents Dec. 1, 2026.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Non-native speakers must validate English proficiency; being exempt from SAT/ACT does not exempt a non-native applicant from English proficiency. Alternatives to the tests below: SAT EBRW 500, ACT English or Reading 18, MET 77, EIKEN Pre-1, IGCSE/O-Level/GCSE/A-Level English grade B or better, completion of a USG campus ESL program or English Composition I with C or better. Conditional admission is available while enrolled in KSU's Intensive English Program (IEP); full admission is reviewed after completing the highest IEP level.

english.notes: Exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026, minimum 4 on the 1-6 scale.
Page lists '115 (Writing Section)'; it is not clear whether the 115 applies to the overall score or only the writing sub-score.

aid.notes: Flight to Excellence Scholarship is an out-of-state tuition waiver (pay in-state tuition plus fees; $5,760 vs $22,290 nonresident tuition in 2026-27) for domestic out-of-state and international students. Freshmen need a 3.5 high school GPA and SAT 1050 / ACT 20 / CLT 68 minimums; it is competitive, limited in number, and renews with a 2.5 GPA for up to 8 semesters. Priority deadline Nov. 2, 2026 for fall 2027 freshmen; no separate application. Dollar value is not published beyond the in-state rate.

majors.notes: Higher requirements and limited seats: 3.0 GPA, SAT 500 EBRW / 570 Math or ACT English-or-Reading 18 / Math 23; apply by Jan. 31 for the following fall.

toefl.note: The international page does not print a TOEFL institution code; look up Kennesaw State University in the ETS search.

tier_notes.computer_science: Editorial judgment: very large computing and software engineering college (CCSE) with ABET-accredited programs; not a top-40 school, so roughly the 41-100 band.
